messages:
sanjay: Quick heads-up — want to schedule a design review for the new model routing + SDK config UI (console + SDK flows). Targeting next Tue/Wed. Pre-read here: https://go/redwood/designs/model-routing-ui :link: 

lina: +1 for a review. I'm available Tue 10–11 PST and Wed 9–11 PST.

kevin: Tue 10:30 I'm oncall, but Tue 11 works for me — prefer 11 if possible. Also need to land the PR before review: https://go/repos/redwood/pr/456

jess: Added a short preread checklist to the doc (see bottom). TL;DR: goals, wireframes, API surface, backward-compat notes, rollout/canary checklist. Please skim before the session.

emily: pinging @ux-team and @platform — we need console mockups and the SDK sequence diagrams by EOD Mon so reviewers have context.

sanjay: Agenda proposal (copy into the doc):
```
- 5m: goals + success criteria
- 15m: console UX walkthrough (emily)
- 15m: SDK flow and examples (kevin)
- 15m: API surface + compatibility notes (kevin/jess)
- 10m: rollout strategy, canary plan, monitoring signals (lina)
- 5m: action items / owners
```

deploy-bot: Reminder: please attach finalized design files to the PR and link the doc to trigger the design-checker job.

kevin: I'll post the API diff tomorrow and add a section for fallback policies. Example snippet I added to the preread:
```http
POST /v1/routing-policy
{
  "priority": ["latency","cost"],
  "fallback": ["small-gpt","hosted-gpt"]
}
```

lina: If Tue 11 PST works for everyone I'll send a calendar invite and mark the pre-reads required. Also added the canary metrics we should monitor to the checklist (p95 latency, token cost, error-rate).

jess: Reviewers requested: @kevin @emily @lina @ops. Please add a :thumbsup: reaction in the doc or here if you can complete preread before the meeting.

emily: :thumbsup: I'll review mockups tonight and leave comments inline.

kevin: :eyes: plan to finish PR + unit tests by Mon morning, will notify when ready.

sanjay: Cool — calendar invite sent for Tue 11 PST, doc updated with meeting note template and checklist. Thanks all — will record and take notes so we can action the rollout items.
